legend: Blanca has a sequence of n$$$n$$$ integers a1,…,an$$$a_1, \ldots, a_n$$$ and a positive integer k$$$k$$$. She can perform operations of the following two types:
Choose an index i$$$i$$$ and add 1$$$1$$$ to ai$$$a_i$$$.
Choose k+1$$$k+1$$$ distinct indices i1,…,ik,ik+1$$$i_1, \ldots, i_k, i_{k+1}$$$, add k$$$k$$$ to aik+1$$$a_{i_{k+1}}$$$, and subtract 1$$$1$$$ from each of ai1,…,aik$$$a_{i_1}, \ldots, a_{i_k}$$$.

Blanca wants to make all n$$$n$$$ numbers equal by applying these operations zero or more times. Help her determine the minimum number of times she needs to perform operations of the first type. (She can perform as many operations of the second type as she wants).
input: The first line contains an integer T$$$T$$$, the number of test cases to process.
Each case consists of a line with two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$, followed by a line with the n$$$n$$$ integers a1,…,an$$$a_1, \ldots, a_n$$$.
output: For each case, print a line with the minimum number of operations of the first type needed to equalize the numbers.
(25 points) The sum of n2$$$n^2$$$ for all cases is at most 106$$$10^6$$$.
note: 2≤n≤106$$$2 \leq n \leq 10^6$$$. The sum of n$$$n$$$ for all cases is at most 106$$$10^6$$$.

legend.ai: Blanca 有一个包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,…,an$$$a_1, \ldots, a_n$$$ 的序列，以及一个正整数 k$$$k$$$。她可以执行以下两种操作：
选择 k+1$$$k+1$$$ 个互不相同的下标 i1,…,ik,ik+1$$$i_1, \ldots, i_k, i_{k+1}$$$，将 aik+1$$$a_{i_{k+1}}$$$ 加 k$$$k$$$，并将 ai1,…,aik$$$a_{i_1}, \ldots, a_{i_k}$$$ 中的每个数减 1$$$1$$$。
Blanca 希望通过执行零次或多次这些操作，使所有 n$$$n$$$ 个数相等。请帮助她确定需要执行第一种操作的最少次数。(她可以任意多次执行第二种操作。)

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 T$$$T$$$，表示需要处理的测试用例数量。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行，表示使这些数字相等所需的第一类操作的最少次数。

note.ai: 对于所有 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$，均有 1≤ai≤109$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$。
